svg.title: Swastik Singh, full-stack software engineer
svg.desc: Datasheet-style masthead. Swastik Singh, full-stack software engineer, B.Tech CSE at Lovely Professional University, based in Delhi and Punjab, India, open to internships and software engineering roles. Figure 1: 500 threads released by one barrier race for a single booking slot; PostgreSQL's exclusion constraint lets exactly one through (booked = 1, conflict = 499), from LPU Reserve's tests/test_concurrency.py.

text.tspan: the double click, the duplicate webhook, the edit made offline.
